description: A safe LibreWolf Violentmonkey user script for Zapia Chat labels and guarded bulk management.

userStories.title: Manage Zapia chats with labels and guarded bulk deletion
userStories.description: As a Zapia user, I can apply managed emoji prefixes, select multiple chats, and start each native deletion flow without allowing the script to confirm destructive dialogs.
acceptanceCriteria: Adds accessible ✔ and 🟡 prefix actions without stacking or duplicating managed prefixes.
Adds selectable chat rows and a selected-count toolbar.
Deletion initiation uses Zapia's visible native controls one chat at a time.
The script never clicks any final deletion confirmation.
Fixture tests cover prefix replacement, row discovery, selection, and exclusion of final confirmation buttons.
userStories.notes: Version 0.1.18 uses an overflow-clipped control layer for Flutter virtual scrolling. Node contracts pass; browser acceptance remains blocked until the persistent Chrome profile is logged in to Zapia.
